dimensions.note: Pure data shaping over workflow artifacts; the report holds no credentials and makes no authenticated calls.
Structured placeholders via the never-throws tryLog wrapper; the new incomplete-query path adds a structured warn ({handle}, {status}) when a query_results artifact did not reach Complete.

Incomplete detection runs inside the existing safeParse-guarded artifact loop; a producer that omits status is treated as complete by design (documented). The never-throws degrade contract is unchanged.

22 tests: prior coverage plus incomplete flagging (Running flagged, Complete and missing status not), warning banner with step/status detail, empty-timeline wording swap under incomplete results, and no-warning path when all queries complete.
Read-only and deterministic for the same artifacts; re-runs are safe.
No external HTTP calls; artifact shapes are validated with zod safeParse before use.
No connections, file handles, temp files, or cloud resources.

Placeholders only: widgets-theme operation names, generic step names (query-changes / query-failed-xyz), RFC 5737 IPs, neutral families; the new docs mention only the generic Logs Insights status vocabulary.
